name: SETUP: enter debug court and grant DUNK MASTER to all 10 players, leave console open
description: Not a regression test — a state-setup helper. Leaves the app parked on the Wolves/Hawks sandbox court with every player holding DUNK MASTER and the in-game debug console open, so a human can immediately type `testGamePlay` and watch spin dunks in both directions. Verifies the grant before handing off so we never hand back a silently-failed setup.

(() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-ready').forEach(n=>n.remove()); const t = (document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-log]')||{}).innerText || ''; const tail = t.slice(t.lastIndexOf('\u2014 current grants \u2014')); const lines = tail.split('\n').filter(l => /(home|away)\/(PG|SG|SF|PF|C):/.test(l)); const homeDunk = lines.filter(l => l.indexOf('home/') !== -1 && l.indexOf('DUNK MASTER') !== -1).length; const awayDunk = lines.filter(l => l.indexOf('away/') !== -1 && l.indexOf('DUNK MASTER') !== -1).length; if (homeDunk === 5 && awayDunk === 5) { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id='probe-ready'; document.body.appendChild(d); } return JSON.stringify({homeDunk, awayDunk}); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION: 5 home AND 5 away players hold DUNK MASTER, read back through hasAbility(). The away half is the point — that is the side whose spin dunk overshot before the rimCx fix.
